verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS travel-and-expense platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control for Navan, its apps, Navan Edge, or the MCP server. The only personalization evidence (Edge using preferences and booking history) is a related feature, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
